harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured and verified inventory-worker on node1. It runs as the dedicated unprivileged inventorysvc account inside a root-owned chroot, with only /var/lib/inventory writable. Service and data recovered after a verified node reboot without changing Ubuntu 7.10 or kernel 2.6.22-14-generic.
actions_performed: Installed and enabled the inventory-worker SysV service for runlevels 2–5.
Verified process identity, chroot root, working directory, and filesystem write restrictions.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified changed boot identity, service recovery, confinement, and persistent data.

evidence.summary: inventorysvc is a system account with /bin/false, no home, and UID 105/GID 112; the recovered service remains active under this account.
The SysV service is enabled, supports managed restart, and automatically recovered after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Root-owned chroot with /var/lib/inventory as the only writable application directory
evidence.summary: The live process root is /srv/inventory-worker and runs as UID/GID 105/112. Direct pre- and post-reboot tests denied writes to /, /bin, /var, and /var/lib while permitting /var/lib/inventory.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic were unchanged across the work and reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID f590092f-3e97-4ef1-9f8e-f5caaad90162; safe reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is 83f014e3-0d67-4b02-bcd0-36784bb99857. inventory-worker recovered with PID 3795, correct confinement, heartbeat, and unchanged persistent-data checksum df46ec8e816560b7404c18696aefd05e.
